  name = file.original_filename.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.]/, "_")
  trace = Trace.new(:name => name, :tagstring => tags, :description => description,
                    :visibility => visibility, :inserted => false, :user => current_user,
                    :timestamp => Time.now.utc, :file => file)
  trace.save!
  if pref = current_user.preferences.find_by(:k => "gps.trace.visibility")
    pref.v = visibility
    pref.save
  else
    current_user.preferences.create(:k => "gps.trace.visibility", :v => visibility)
  end
  trace
end

IssueComment.body: Taking a look at this report.

summary: openstreetmap-website: the Ruby on Rails application powering the OpenStreetMap website & API v0.6 — user accounts (email/password + OAuth), diary/blog with comments & subscriptions, user-to-user messaging & follow/mute, map editing via versioned nodes/ways/relations written through open changesets, map notes with status lifecycle & comments, GPX trace uploads/import, changeset discussions, and a moderation layer (roles, user blocks, issues/reports, redactions, moderation zones, spam/ACL denylists).

_no_edges.why: pure external email dispatch with no persisted record — no data touch (app/controllers/passwords_controller.rb:35)
oauth callback; handled through auth/read; no additional direct edge beyond its own effects (app/controllers/users_controller.rb:128)
reads Settings config only, no DB row op (app/controllers/api/capabilities_controller.rb:16)
reads Settings config only, no DB row op (app/controllers/api/versions_controller.rb:14)
read-only owner-scoped listing, no cross-op or guard beyond session (app/controllers/notifications_controller.rb:48)
